headline: Fed Holds Rates Steady at October Meeting
text: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark interest rate steady at its October meeting, signaling patience as inflation continues its gradual decline. Bond markets rallied on the news.

headline: Tech Sector Posts Strong Q3 Earnings
text: Major tech companies reported better-than-expected Q3 earnings, with the Nasdaq composite rising 2.1%. Cloud computing and AI infrastructure spending drove growth.

headline: Municipal Bond Yields Reach 5-Year High
text: Municipal bond yields climbed to their highest level in five years as supply increased. Tax-exempt income seekers may find attractive entry points in MUB and similar funds.

headline: Celebrity Chef Opens New Restaurant in Miami
text: Award-winning chef opens a new waterfront restaurant in Miami's Brickell district, featuring a fusion menu.

headline: Housing Market Shows Signs of Cooling
text: Home sales fell 3.2% in September as mortgage rates remained elevated. Analysts expect further softening through year-end, potentially benefiting buyers waiting on the sidelines.

headline: International Markets Rally on Trade Deal Optimism
text: European and Asian markets surged following progress on a new trade agreement. VTIAX and other international funds could benefit from continued momentum.

headline: Popular Streaming Service Raises Prices Again
text: A leading streaming platform announced another round of price increases, citing rising content costs.

headline: Tax-Loss Harvesting Season: What Advisors Need to Know
text: With Q4 underway, advisors should review client portfolios for tax-loss harvesting opportunities. Positions with significant unrealized losses like ARKK may be candidates for strategic selling.

headline: New Study Links Coffee to Longevity
text: Researchers published findings suggesting moderate coffee consumption is associated with increased lifespan.

headline: Dividend Aristocrats Outperform in Volatile Market
text: High-dividend stocks and funds like VYM have outperformed growth benchmarks over the past quarter as investors seek income stability.

headline: RMD Rule Changes for 2027: Key Updates
text: The IRS finalized updated Required Minimum Distribution rules for 2027, affecting inherited IRAs and Roth conversions. Advisors should review client accounts for compliance.

headline: Electric Vehicle Sales Surge in Q3
text: EV sales increased 28% year-over-year in Q3 2026, with Tesla maintaining market leadership despite growing competition.
